scope: Arcanea Records product-local IDs; Empire Registry promotion pending

identities.name: Arcanea Records
identities.listening_promise: One house for the complete roster
identities.sonic_boundary: Curated electronic, songs, piano and world scores
identities.why_separate: Label administration; never an extra primary artist
identities.next_gate: Verify contracting entity and name; select distributor
identities.notes: The imprint can release founder music and independent acts; a release need not be official Arcanea world canon.

identities.name: Frank X
identities.listening_promise: Emotional, modern music with piano, physical bass and memorable hooks
identities.sonic_boundary: DnB, house/tech house, electronic-rock crossover; one coherent era at a time
identities.cadence_proposal: Every 3–4 weeks during first 90 days; 2 weeks only after backlog and results
identities.why_separate: Own human stage identity; preserves founder equity
identities.next_gate: Exact-name rights review and existing account/artist-ID audit
identities.notes: Use real Frank in biography and credits. AI singing is credited as generated; it is not represented as Frank's own recorded vocal. Keep exact DSP spelling consistent. FrankX remains the business styling.

identities.name: Frank Riemer
identities.listening_promise: Intimate piano and expansive chamber/orchestral listening
identities.sonic_boundary: Instrumental piano, chamber and original orchestral pieces; no unrelated club release in this lane
identities.cadence_proposal: Every 4–6 weeks if a separate listening contract is proved
identities.why_separate: Different listening occasion, cover language, cue catalog and long-form audience
identities.next_gate: Audition 3–5 pieces, audit existing profile, choose split or Frank X Sessions
identities.notes: Recommended separate catalog if recurring, not because classical requires a legal name. Suno piano belongs only with honest generative and human-performance credits. Historical files used this as the main artist; current founder direction changes that.

identities.name: Starlight
identities.listening_promise: Ascendant, stage-scale music and performance eras
identities.sonic_boundary: Retain Starlight in My Mind album world; series does not overwrite album narrator
identities.why_separate: A visual/album chapter can carry this identity without another artist account
identities.next_gate: Identify each recording's narrator and hosting artist
identities.notes: Standalone artist use is crowded in music searches. A distinct voice and independently wanted catalog would justify reconsideration.

identities.name: Arcanea
identities.sonic_boundary: World identity and release series; use specific artist credits for recordings
identities.cadence_proposal: Project/score commissions, not a second generic feed
identities.why_separate: World umbrella already has a role; artist and label should remain intelligible
identities.next_gate: Audit any historical Arcanea artist profile and composition/recording ownership
identities.notes: The label is Arcanea Records. The world is Arcanea. The name alone does not identify a performer or prove lore approval.

identities.name: Alera
identities.listening_promise: A recognizable fictional voice tied to an approved Arcanea character
identities.sonic_boundary: Anchor voice and repertoire from retrieved canon, not a genre-dump
identities.cadence_proposal: Three-song proof, then seasonal 4–6-week releases if admitted
identities.why_separate: Distinct narrator, timbre, character and fan relationship
identities.next_gate: Resolve exact music conflicts; retrieve current authorized canon and voice anchor
identities.notes: Existing Alera canon remains a source, not legal clearance. Melbourne band and other music profiles use Alera. Do not re-author character or infer healthcare benefits from frequency lore.

identities.name: Nonaca
identities.sonic_boundary: Do not assume Nonaca is a rename of Nona
identities.cadence_proposal: None until role and ownership resolve
identities.why_separate: Separate only for stable narrator/voice and three coherent recordings
identities.next_gate: Confirm spelling, relationship to Nona, and ownership of She's Beautiful profile
identities.notes: Amazon Music has an exact Nonaca profile. It may be your catalog; ownership is unknown. This is an attribution task before a naming conclusion.

identities.name: Nona
identities.listening_promise: Preserve raw punk vulnerability and angel/devil album concepts
identities.sonic_boundary: Historical character and repertoire; no automatic migration to Nonaca or NYRA
identities.why_separate: Valuable musical DNA independent of a final public name
identities.next_gate: Reconcile historical audio and character identity
identities.notes: Keep source concepts including First Confession and Saints and Sinners. Prior assistant proposal to migrate to NYRA KESTREL is not a founder approval.

identities.name: Akamoro
identities.sonic_boundary: First test as Frank X track/series; language does not require an alias
identities.why_separate: New identity needs a distinct narrator/performance contract, not a Japanese tag
identities.next_gate: Confirm Akamoro vs historical Akamoto; linguistic review; in-app handle audit
identities.notes: No exact music artist located in this scoped web pass; indexed Instagram @akamoro exists. A Japanese-sounding name is not evidence of Japanese origin or meaning.

identities.name: Ocean Muses
identities.listening_promise: Water, intimacy and motion through a recognizable vocal collective
identities.sonic_boundary: Liquid DnB, soulful garage/deep house, organic percussion; motif and recurring voice palette
identities.cadence_proposal: Three-song pilot; then one single every 4–6 weeks if admitted
identities.why_separate: Plural creates room for voices and collaborations with a coherent emotional world
identities.next_gate: Blind audition proof; name variants/register review; define human/virtual membership
identities.notes: Strongest additional concept in this roster, by strategic judgment. The Siren Cycle remains an era, not a new act. Use honest member/voice provenance.

identities.name: The Arcanean Orchestra
identities.listening_promise: World scores and orchestral records with traceable contributors
identities.sonic_boundary: Original orchestral/chamber world pieces; truthful ensemble/performance credits
identities.cadence_proposal: Project-based EP/score; no forced singles treadmill
identities.why_separate: Distinct score and ensemble presentation when catalog warrants
identities.next_gate: Audit existing canon/router, real vs virtual ensemble credits and profiles
identities.notes: Recovered September strategy references this identity. Existence of a named ensemble does not establish an employed human orchestra or released masters.

identities.name: Billionaire Muses
identities.sonic_boundary: Test as collection under Frank X or Ocean Muses, not a new act
identities.why_separate: Avoid separating fans solely by escalating wealth titles
identities.next_gate: Audience meaning test; nearby Millionaire Muses ownership and trademark check
identities.notes: An aspirational title can fit a song or collection. It is weaker as a long-term artistic promise than Ocean Muses; do not imply financial outcomes.

identities.name: Trillionaire Muses
identities.sonic_boundary: Same host catalog; no independent persona
identities.why_separate: Number escalation alone adds no distinct voice or listener relationship
identities.next_gate: Exact and similar register/DSP checks; compare title comprehension
identities.notes: No exact artist located in scoped indexed searches. This is not a finding of legal availability.

identities.name: Quadrillionaire Muses
identities.sonic_boundary: Archive as title candidate; avoid hierarchy of musician accounts
identities.why_separate: Long spelling and hyperbole make fan recall harder; strategic judgment, not research result
identities.next_gate: Keep in research; do not launch a standalone act
identities.notes: If used, it should earn meaning through a specific composition or story rather than a numerical upgrade.

identities.name: Vibe OS Sessions
identities.listening_promise: Useful music for focus, movement, gratitude and rest
identities.sonic_boundary: Preserve Music for Becoming activity and perspective contracts
identities.cadence_proposal: Weekly private creation; curated public pieces in host cadence
identities.why_separate: Functional use cases can be playlists and bundles across the roster
identities.next_gate: Audit historical Lumen/Frank's Vibes routing and rights
identities.notes: Generation/private listening can scale independently from commercial release cadence. No assumed therapeutic or performance effects.

identities.name: NYRA KESTREL
identities.listening_promise: Prior proposed Western rap/punk/metal virtual act
identities.sonic_boundary: Preserve proposal and links; no assumed launch approval
identities.why_separate: Candidate if Nona/Nonaca DNA needs a final coherent performer
identities.next_gate: Founder decision required before further setup
identities.notes: Recovered from August proposal. Current user did not select this name.
